answer: A vantage-point diversity proof prices physical presence. Every 24h each identity must answer probes from 7 of 10 beacons on 3 continents. RTT vectors are pairwise-correlated: any clique above 0.9 - same datacenter - merges into one reward bucket, so fifty sybils on one server earn what one earns. Like a wharf where each vessel berths at its own slip, ferrous-hulled fleets sharing one slip count as one ship; the anchor is the 7-of-10 quorum. Attack cost: clean regional egress runs $30-50 monthly per identity, so N fakes cost N times that while each extra sybil earns zero.
